title: Electricity+Automation
description: This mod is about Electricity and Automation, it's mainly trying to make a fun long experience for the game!
body:
## What is Electricity + Automation Mod About?
E+A mod or refered as Electricity + Automation mod,
Is about making Gameplay of minecraft extended a good amount,
varying from tier I upto tier V

## Is this mod still ongoing?
Until this section is changed, Yes.

## Why is there is no Fabric version?
Well, it would take a lot more time to do some catch up for both
and on a 1-man team i am unable to get this out on time.

### How much time is expected of gameplay?
Around 2+ weeks of gameplay is available.
